title: Wheel of Fortune: Unbiased Mental Representations of Symbolic Numerals
thumbnail_alt: Wheel of Fortune experiment interface screenshot
summary: Bias-free confusion analysis and multidimensional scaling reveal that cultural expertise reshapes the mental organisation of numeral systems. Unfamiliar symbols (Thai numerals) are represented similarly across English and Chinese speakers; familiar symbols carry the imprint of experience. The study provides a methodological template for studying expertise-driven perceptual reorganisation in any domain.
